card.name: Odd symbols used as less-than or bullets
card.fires_on: Unusual symbol characters (a modifier-style less-than sign or a broken-encoding character) that stand in for "<" before a number or for a bullet marker in a list. They appear in dosing tables and drug-label step lists.

modes.label: Less-than sign before a number
modes.description: A rare less-than character placed before a value in a table or criterion.
modes.example: 10 to ˂30 Standard individual dose given every 24 hours <<˂>>10 (without hemodialysis)

modes.label: Broken bullet character
modes.description: A garbled encoding character that works as a list bullet or comparison sign in label text.
modes.example: ͦ Transfer dextrose injection to the PN container. <<�>>� Transfer amino acid injection.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed Chinese and code fragments, so there is no clear output effect on drug text.
card.plain: It fires on strange symbols that stand in for a less-than sign or a bullet point in label tables and lists.
